cues: Dylan Thomas was born in Swansea, in south Wales, in nineteen fourteen, and published his first book of poems at twenty.
He was a poet of sound before sense, building lines out of alliteration and rhyme, and reading them in a famous deep voice.
He is often called a late Romantic.
He worked for the BBC from nineteen forty five, and died in New York in nineteen fifty three, aged thirty nine.
